title: Ad Orientem 1962 Missa Cantata Certified Form Profile

SIMPLE_NO_INCENSE.minimum_model: two servers; optional MC/torchbearers per ceremonial

SOLEMNIZED_WITH_INCENSE.model: MC + thurifer + two acolytes + torchbearers; no sacred ministers

global_rules: Never infer Missa Cantata as Solemn Mass minus ministers; use this explicit profile.
Choir and celebrant remain independent concurrent lanes.
Responses sung by choir are not duplicated by servers.
No separate private celebrant Gospel is created.
Requiem and Asperges remain their own research/form gates.

deviations.finding: Missa Cantata has no deacon or subdeacon.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Never instantiate sacred-minister actors merely because the Mass is sung.

deviations.finding: Simple form: two servers, no incense. More solemn form: MC, thurifer, two acolytes, torchbearers, incense.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Do not force incense/staffing as constitutive of Missa Cantata.

deviations.finding: Responses sung by choir are not duplicated by servers.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Separate choir/public-response lane from server-response lane.

deviations.finding: Celebrant may sit during protracted sung portions according to sung-Mass ceremonial.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Use chant-duration/state triggers; do not infer from Solemn ministers sitting.

deviations.finding: Eligible cleric may sing Epistle; otherwise celebrant reads or chants.
deviations.runtime_consequence: No subdeacon; no duplicate celebrant Epistle when eligible cleric sings.

deviations.finding: Celebrant himself proclaims the public Gospel.
deviations.runtime_consequence: No deacon actor or Solemn Gospel procession inference.
deviations.authority: OC64 ch. XX; RG60 sung-Mass topology

deviations.finding: In incense profile celebrant incenses the Gospel book; no post-Gospel incensation of celebrant is generated.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Keep Gospel incense, suppress deacon/celebrant-after-Gospel Solemn topology.

deviations.finding: Incense profile has full Offertory incensation with roles reassigned to MC/thurifer.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Do not import deacon/subdeacon actor names.

deviations.finding: Incense profile adds thurifer incensation at both elevations.
deviations.runtime_consequence: Overlay on the same canonical elevation events.
deviations.authority: MR62 Ritus VIII; 1962 Missa Cantata incense rule
